title: Project agent connection
responsibility: Sends authenticated project requests and follows only the run that belongs to this conversation.

inputs.name: agentRequestKey.input
inputs.description: The startRun input whose retry key is built: its conversation, branch and commit keys are left out and the other keys are sorted by name. Null and undefined throw, because Object.entries cannot read their keys.

inputs.unknownReason: The adapter accepts action-specific values and derives a retry key from their enumerable entries.

inputs.name: definitiveAgentFailure.cause
inputs.description: The value a send call rejected with; only its status property is read, as a number. Only a status from 400 to 499 other than 408 and 429 counts as definitive, so a network failure (status 0) or a value without a status does not.
inputs.unknownReason: A rejected transport can supply any value; only a numeric status participates in retry classification.

inputs.name: AgentHttpAdapter.constructor.send
inputs.description: The transport for every project request: it receives the project id and the AgentCall body and resolves with the project API's response value. Its rejection is rethrown unchanged by call, and it is also used for the 'events' polls.
inputs.unknownReason: The transport serves multiple operations whose responses have different shapes.

inputs.name: AgentHttpAdapter.shown.snapshot
inputs.description: The project snapshot being shown; its writable flag, capabilities.agents, revision atTip flag and cache status decide whether the project keeps a branch-tip view. A view is kept only when the snapshot is writable, agents is enabled, the revision is at the tip, the cache is not offline and the query has no commit; otherwise the project's view is removed.

capabilities.reason: Write access: comments and AI requests.

inputs.name: AgentHttpAdapter.shown.query
inputs.description: The revision query the snapshot answered; a commit that is set means a historical view, so the project's view is removed instead of kept. The query's branch is not stored, because the view records the snapshot's own branch and commit.

inputs.name: AgentHttpAdapter.listen.listener
inputs.description: Receives each RunEvent delivered for a run this adapter started, plus its own 'status' (reconnecting) or 'failed' (access refused) event when a poll fails. It stays registered until the function returned by listen is called; an exception it throws is treated as a poll failure, and if it throws again for that event, polling of the run stops.

inputs.name: AgentHttpAdapter.call.method
inputs.description: The agent method name written to the request body; 'startRun', 'approve' and 'openThread' are changes that need a recorded branch-tip view and get a revision and a requestId, while any other name, such as 'events', is sent as given.

inputs.name: AgentHttpAdapter.call.input
inputs.description: The input written to the request body unchanged; for 'startRun' it is the payload whose retry key is checked, and for 'events' it is { runId, after }, the run and the sequence after which events are requested.

examples.text: Plan a pricing page with three tiers.

inputs.unknownReason: The selected agent action determines the payload shape, and the adapter forwards the payload to that action.

inputs.name: AgentHttpAdapter.call.projectId
inputs.description: The project id that selects the recorded view and pending start for the call, and that is passed to send, which addresses the project with it. The adapter does not validate the id; access checks and credentials belong to send.

outputs.name: agentRequestKey
outputs.description: The JSON text that identifies a startRun for retries: the input without conversation, branch and commit, with keys sorted and no spaces. A retry with an equal key resends the original request, and a different key is refused while an earlier start is unacknowledged.
examples: {"category":"pages","effort":"xhigh","intent":"create","mode":"plan","model":"claude-opus-5-5","projectId":"c3f1a9e2-5b7d-4e8a-9c1f-2d6b8a4e7f30","provider":"claude","text":"Plan a pricing page with three tiers."}

{"category":"components","effort":"xhigh","intent":"task","mode":"change","model":"claude-opus-5-5","projectId":"c3f1a9e2-5b7d-4e8a-9c1f-2d6b8a4e7f30","provider":"claude","text":"Show the capture time on each evidence card."}

outputs.name: definitiveAgentFailure
outputs.description: True when the cause is a definitive 4xx refusal other than 408 or 429, so a failed startRun clears its pending start and a failed poll stops following the run. False otherwise, which keeps the start pending for retry and the poll reconnecting.

outputs.name: AgentHttpAdapter.shown
outputs.description: shown records or removes the project's branch-tip view and returns nothing, so the value is always undefined.

outputs.name: AgentHttpAdapter.listen
outputs.description: The unsubscribe function for this listener; calling it removes the listener and returns true if it was still registered, or false if it had already been removed.

outputs.name: AgentHttpAdapter.call
outputs.description: Resolves with the value send resolved with, unchanged, and a resolved startRun also starts polling its runId. Rejects with the rejection from send, unchanged, or with an Error or TypeError raised by the checks described in errors.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown when a 'startRun' input is null or undefined or cannot be serialized (for example a BigInt or a cycle), or when a 'startRun' resolves with null or undefined.

errors.name: AgentBranchTipViewRequiredError
errors.description: A startRun, approve, or openThread request requires a recorded writable branch-tip view.

errors.name: UnacknowledgedAgentRequestError
errors.description: A new startRun request conflicts with the unacknowledged run when its retry key differs.
